children: Livestock futures are mixed with cattle adding to last week's gains and hogs extending their slide. Last week's cattle slaughter fell by 21,000 head but was more than 11,000 above the 2025 Labor Holiday week, AgResource says in a note. And while last week's boxed beef prices were slightly lower, both choice and select values remain well above late-July lows, the firm adds. "September is typically a slow month for the beef market, with seasonal demand developing in October." Live cattle rise 0.3% on CME. Lean hogs are off 2%. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
